lead: The rolling competitive intelligence window highlights vendor activity in EFB, flight planning, and crew operations, led by Jeppesen and Lufthansa Systems in volume. Key customer adoptions and product enhancements demonstrate ongoing digitalization across global carriers, with prominent platform updates in AI and modular features.

insights.title: Jeppesen Introduces AI Agents in ForeFlight
insights.finding: Jeppesen launched initial AI agents and Airflow agents for its ForeFlight aviation operations platform, aiming to assist with planning workflows.
insights.aviation_context: AI agents are integrated into flight operations platforms to streamline pilot and dispatcher tasks.
insights.caveat: Specific adoption rates and performance impacts are not detailed in the sources.

insights.title: IFS Secures Regional and LCC EFB Wins
insights.finding: IFS expanded its EFB footprint by securing EFBOne platform selections from fastjet and TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is an African low-cost carrier (LCC), and TUS Airways operates as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Implementation timelines and fleet rollout statuses vary by announcement.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Enhances Lido mPilot and Flight 4D
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems released Lido mPilot 7.3 with aircraft-specific taxiway restrictions and highlighted ongoing Lido Flight 4D implementations like Kenya Airways.
insights.aviation_context: Airport Moving Maps and digital flight planning tools support flight crew situational awareness and dispatch efficiency.
insights.caveat: Evidence is limited to captured release notes and customer deployment announcements.

insights.title: Aviobook and Navblue Secure Airline Agreements
insights.finding: Aviobook secured a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc for the AvioBook Flight EFB, while Navblue expanded its Skywise collaboration with TransNusa.
insights.aviation_context: EFB platforms and digital suites centralize cockpit documentation and flight operations data.
insights.caveat: Commercial terms beyond the announced agreement lengths are not specified.

insights.title: Bytron Skybook Updates EFB and Ground Portal
insights.finding: Bytron Skybook released version 1.52.0 of its EFB and Ground Portal, incorporating customizable settings, checklists, and fuel fields.
insights.aviation_context: Updates to ground portals and EFB applications assist flight dispatchers and pilots in managing operational data.
insights.caveat: Adoption metrics for version 1.52.0 across existing customer airlines are not provided.
